name: Ushiku (Japan)
description: A maroon field charged at the centre with the Ushiku city emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric lines with a stylised character of horizontal strokes at the fly.
history: Municipal flag of Ushiku, a city in Ibaraki Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 July 1960.

features.role: Ushiku city emblem — an outlined ring of concentric lines with a stylised character of horizontal strokes at the fly
